name: frontend-design
description: Distinctive visual direction: named palette, deliberate type pairing, and one aesthetic risk per brief.

name: dataviz
trigger: before writing any chart, graph, or dashboard code
description: One consistent visual system for data: color formula, mark specs, accessible-by-default palettes.

name: artifact-design
description: Calibrates how much design investment a given artifact request actually warrants.

name: decision-checkpoints
trigger: long autonomous runs that hit a real design fork
description: Pause and ask at genuine forks instead of silently guessing or free-texting a question.

name: code-review
trigger: reviewing a working diff before merge
description: Structured review pass over changed code, findings ranked by severity, verified before reporting.

name: simplify
trigger: after a feature lands and needs a cleanup pass
description: Cuts duplication, dead abstraction, and premature generality from just-changed code only.

name: update-config
trigger: "allow X", "add permission", "when Claude stops, do Y"
description: Wires hooks, permissions, and env vars through settings.json instead of relying on memory.

name: security-review
trigger: pending changes touch auth, input handling, or infra
description: Audits a diff for injection, auth, and OWASP-class issues before it ships.

name: loop
trigger: "check this every 5 minutes", recurring polling asks
description: Runs a prompt or slash command on an interval, fixed or self-paced.

name: schedule
trigger: "remind me tomorrow at 9am", recurring cloud agents
description: Creates and manages cron-based routines that run independent of an open session.

name: project-tracking-docs
trigger: start of a feature, fix, or refactor
description: Keeps a PLAN/BUGFIX doc current automatically as implementation work lands, unasked.

name: claude-api
trigger: questions about model IDs, pricing, streaming, tool use
description: Reference for the Claude API and Anthropic SDK — caching, token counting, migrations.
